statement: Same-height collision: the frame with the higher proof slot wins, and at the first collision on a head that is Left's, so Left wins; the loser rolls back and re-proposes its txs at the next height.

killers.name: R-A1 Left ignores Right's frame and keeps its own

R-A1 the rolled-back txs go ahead of what Right queued later

R-A1 R-PARENT heights differ by at most one, in every state of the page
R-A1 R-PARENT no tx committed twice, in every state of the page
R-A1 each side's txs commit in submission order, in every state of the page
R-A1 R-REACK nothing wedges: a finished world is reachable from every state
